headline.en: A Geospatial & Engineering Partner You Can Build On
headline.sw: Mshirika wa Kijiografia na Uhandisi Unaoweza Kutegemewa

description.en:
SmartGrid Surveying & Civil Works Ltd is a professional geospatial and engineering firm delivering precision land surveying, UAV mapping, GIS analysis, underground utility detection, and civil infrastructure solutions.

 From our base in Nairobi we serve government agencies, NGOs, private developers, and donor-funded programmes across Kenya and Africa — combining cutting-edge RTK GNSS, drone LiDAR, and total station technologies with disciplined project management to turn spatial data into confident decisions.
description.sw:
SmartGrid Surveying & Civil Works Ltd ni kampuni ya kitaalamu ya kijiografia na uhandisi inayotoa huduma za upimaji ardhi wa usahihi, ramani za UAV, uchambuzi wa GIS, utambuzi wa huduga za chini ya ardhi, na suluhisho za miundombinu ya civil.

 Kutoka ofisi yetu jijini Nairobi tunahudumia wakala za serikali, NGOs, wasanidi binafsi, na miradi ya wafadhili barani Kenya na Afrika — tukichanganya teknolojia za kisasa za RTK GNSS, drone LiDAR, na total stations pamoja na usimamizi mwepesi wa mradi ili kugeuza data ya anga kuwa maamuzi yenye uhakika.
